title: National Disaster Preparedness Baseline Assessment: Barbados
temporal_coverage: 2024 national disaster-preparedness risk and vulnerability assessment with parish-level exposure, vulnerability and capacity composites.
methodology: Opened the complete 124-page assessment, reviewing hazard exposure, parish vulnerability, island capacity and disaster-management findings.
limitations: The maps and composite scores are multi-hazard assessments, not climate-specific causal estimates or records of observed losses.

title: The Barbados Integrated Coastal Zone Management Plan, Volume 2, Segment 2
organization: Coastal Zone Management Unit, Government of Barbados
temporal_coverage: Volume 2 Part B and Part C of the coastal management plan dated October 2020; includes coastal risk assessment summaries and guidance for future management.
methodology: Opened full 127-page Part B/C segment, including risk summaries, SWOT and national guidance.
limitations: Part D sub-area maps were not reviewed; damage estimates use dated asset data and the plan is not an implementation evaluation.

title: Barbados Voluntary National Review 2023
organization: Government of Barbados, Office of the Prime Minister
geographic_coverage: southern and western coastal urban corridor
temporal_coverage: Government SDG progress review submitted in 2023; includes 2021 Hurricane Elsa impacts and summaries of coastal-risk and resilience initiatives.
methodology: Opened the full 246-page national review and read its climate, disaster-impact, coastal-risk and adaptation-program passages.
limitations: The review summarizes other assessments and administrative reports; older figures and stated initiatives are not independently evaluated here.

title: Barbados – Beryl Emergency Response and Recovery Project: Project Information Document
temporal_coverage: Appraisal-stage project document covering Hurricane Beryl impacts in 2024, immediate recovery actions and the proposed emergency-response project.
methodology: Opened the 16-page appraisal PID on Beryl impacts, sector context, response and project objectives.
limitations: Appraisal PID, not completion evaluation; it cites Fisheries Division damage figures and does not attribute Beryl to climate change.

title: Participatory Recovery Planning Workshop
temporal_coverage: Fisherfolk survey findings and a community-recovery planning workshop held on 22 January 2026 after Hurricane Beryl.
methodology: Opened the full agency post summarizing PACIFICO survey findings and the January 2026 workshop with landing-site representatives.
limitations: The post does not provide the survey sample size, instrument, site-level results or sex-disaggregated findings.

title: Barbados Coastal Fisheries Resilience
temporal_coverage: Japan-funded UNDP coastal-fisheries recovery initiative following Hurricane Beryl; the project page reports a March 2025 start, December 2027 end and ongoing status.
methodology: Opened the UNDP project page and reviewed its background, objectives, expected results, dates and status.
limitations: The page describes intended outputs and reports ongoing status, not evaluated outcomes; its estimate of vessel damage differs from the World Bank PID.
